sources.title: Low-Calorie Diet and Supervised Exercise May Reverse Early Onset Type 2 Diabetes
Genetic 'dimmer switch' can protect against severe disease in rare muscular dystrophy

en.title: RESET Trial Shows 54% Remission in Early Type 2 Diabetes Patients
en.dek: The RESET for Remission trial reported that 54% of adults with early onset type 2 diabetes entered remission after six months of a low calorie diet and supervised exercise.
facts: The RESET for Remission trial included 96 adults from England and Canada who had early onset type 2 diabetes, obesity, and were not on insulin treatment.
Participants in the intervention group followed an 800–900-calorie-per-day diet during the first 12 weeks.
At 24 weeks, 54% of the intervention group entered remission compared with 4% in the control group.
Researchers defined remission as an HbA1c level below 6.5% without glucose-lowering medication for at least 12 weeks.
body: The trial, presented at the 2026 European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) Annual Meeting and published in The Lancet Regional Health Americas on October 1, included adults aged 18 to 45 who had early onset type 2 diabetes.
The intervention group ate a low calorie diet consisting of 30% protein, 50% carbohydrate, and 20% fat during the initial 12 weeks, while the control group received usual care alone.
During weeks 13–24, participants transitioned to a weight-maintenance diet and independent exercise, and both groups were supervised by physicians.
David Cutler, MD, a board certified family medicine physician at Providence Saint John’s Health Center in Santa Monica, CA, stated that diet and exercise can improve or resolve diabetes.
en.context: Early onset type 2 diabetes is diagnosed before age 45, and this condition may carry a higher risk of microvascular complications and adverse cardiovascular outcomes, according to Healthline.

fr.title: Essai RESET : 54 % de rémission chez les patients diabétiques de type 2 à début précoce
fr.dek: Le trial RESET pour la rémission a indiqué que 54 % des adultes atteints de diabète de type 2 à début précoce sont entrés en rémission après six mois d'un régime hypocalorique et d'un exercice supervisé.
facts: L'essai RESET pour la rémission a inclus 96 adultes d'Angleterre et du Canada atteints de diabète de type 2 à début précoce, d'obésité et ne suivant pas de traitement à l'insuline.
Les participants au groupe intervention ont suivi un régime de 800 à 900 calories par jour pendant les douze premières semaines.
À 24 semaines, 54 % du groupe intervention sont entrés en rémission contre 4 % dans le groupe témoin.
Les chercheurs ont défini la rémission comme un taux d'HbA1c inférieur à 6,5 % sans médicaments hypoglycémiants pendant au moins 12 semaines.
body: L'essai, présenté lors de la réunion annuelle 2026 de l'Association européenne pour l'étude du diabète (EASD) et publié dans The Lancet Regional Health Americas le 1er octobre, concernait des adultes âgés de 18 à 45 ans atteints d'un diabète de type 2 à début précoce.

Le groupe interventionnel a suivi un régime hypocalorique composé de 30 % de protéines, 50 % de glucides et 20 % de lipides pendant les douze premières semaines, tandis que le groupe témoin n'a reçu que les soins usuels.
Durant les semaines 13 à 24, les participants ont basculé vers un régime de maintien du poids et une activité physique indépendante, les deux groupes étant supervisés par des médecins.

David Cutler, MD, médecin de famille certifié par le conseil d'administration au Providence Saint John’s Health Center de Santa Monica en Californie, a déclaré que l'alimentation et l'exercice peuvent améliorer ou résoudre le diabète.
fr.context: Le diabète de type 2 à début précoce est diagnostiqué avant 45 ans, et cette pathologie peut présenter un risque accru de complications microvasculaires et d'événements cardiovasculaires défavorables, selon Healthline.

zh.title: RESET 试验显示早期2型糖尿病患者54%进入缓解状态
zh.dek: RESET 缓解试验报告称，在低热量饮食和监督锻炼六个月后，54%的早发性2型糖尿病成年人进入缓解状态。
facts: 该试验包括96名来自英格兰和加拿大、患有早发性2型糖尿病、肥胖且未接受胰岛素治疗的成年人。
干预组在前12周遵循每日800–900卡路里的饮食。
24周时，干预组有54%进入缓解状态，对照组为4%。
研究人员将缓解定义为HbA1c水平低于6.5%，且至少12周不使用降糖药物。
body: 该研究于2026年欧洲糖尿病研究协会年会上展示，并于10月1日在《区域健康美洲》期刊上发表。研究纳入了18至45岁、患有早发性2型糖尿病的成年人。
干预组在最初12周内摄入低热量饮食，其营养成分配比为蛋白质30%、碳水化合物50%、脂肪20%；对照组仅接受常规护理。
13至24周期间，参与者转为体重维持饮食并进行独立锻炼，两组均由医生监督。
普罗维登斯圣约翰健康中心的认证家庭医学医生大卫·卡特勒表示，饮食和运动可以改善或逆转糖尿病。
zh.context: 早发性2型糖尿病在45岁前诊断，据Healthline称，该病可能带来更高的微血管并发症和不良心血管结局风险。

ko.title: RESET 임상시험, 초기 제2형 당뇨병 환자 54% 관해 달성
ko.dek: RESET for Remission 임상시험 결과, 저칼로리 식단과 감독된 운동 6개월 후 초기 발병 제2형 당뇨병 성인 54%가 관해 상태에 진입한 것으로 나타남
facts: RESET for Remission 임상시험에는 초기 발병 제2형 당뇨병, 비만으로 인해 인슐린 치료를 받지 않는 영국 및 캐나다 성인 96명이 참여함
중재군 참가자들은 처음 12주 동안 하루 800~900칼로리 식단을 따름
24주 시점에서 중재군은 54%가 관해 상태에 진입한 반면 대조군은 4%에 불과했음
연구진은 관해를 혈당 강하제 없이 HbA1c 수치가 6.5% 미만인 상태가 최소 12주 이상 지속되는 것으로 정의함
body: 해당 임상시험은 2026년 유럽당뇨병연구학회(EASD) 연례 회의에서 발표되었으며 10월 1일 The Lancet Regional Health Americas에 게재되었고, 조기 발병 제2형 당뇨병을 앓는 18세에서 45세 성인을 대상으로 했다.
중재군은 초기 12주 동안 단백질 30%, 탄수화물 50%, 지방 20%로 구성된 저칼로리 식단을 섭취한 반면, 대조군은 일반적인 치료만을 받았다.
13주차부터 24주차까지 참가자들은 체중 유지 식단과 자율 운동으로 전환했으며, 두 그룹 모두 의사의 감독을 받았다.
캘리포니아주 산타모니카의 프로비던스 세인트 존스 헬스 센터 소속 전문의인 데이비드 커틀러 박사는 식단과 운동이 당뇨병을 개선하거나 해결할 수 있다고 밝혔다.
ko.context: Healthline에 따르면 초기 발병 제2형 당뇨병은 45세 이전에 진단되며, 이 질환은 미세혈관 합병증 및 심혈관 부작용 발생 위험이 더 높을 수 있음

problemsFixed: The headline is not a purely factual statement of what happened and is too vague.
The dek is not a single-sentence summary and is too long.
The body contains unsupported claims or misattributes findings (e.g., 'Researchers found that more than half...').
The body contains an unsupported quote attribution ('according to Healthline' for Cutler's statement).
The context relies on unsupported attributions ('according to Healthline') for factual definitions and risks.
The structure does not adhere to rhythm requirements (varying sentence length, avoiding four short declarative sentences in a row).
The body paragraphs do not open with the actor, number, document, or date.
